2608.02148.title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
2608.02148.paper_summary: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage. Stage 2 supplements semantic sufficiency, the property that an embedding is grounded in retrieval-relevant evidence and preserves fine-grained counterpart-side semantics, via two mechanisms. Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning organizes retrieval evidence through hidden-space latent reasoning, and Cross-Conditional Reconstruction enforces counterpart-side semantics through cross-directional autoregressive reconstruction. Both act only during training and add only marginal query-side overhead, so DME serves as efficiently as a standard contrastive encoder. On MMEB-v2, DME reaches state-of-the-art results at comparable scales for its 2B and 9B variants (74.8 and 78.4), with especially strong video and visual-document tasks. In production, DME delivers a 2.92% relative gain on Douyin's in-house offline evaluation set, is deployed across Douyin scenarios such as generative, image, and AI search, and yields a 0.1% Lifetime (LT) gain in online A/B testing on Douyin search.
2608.02148.paper_summary_zh: 多模態表示學習是現代人工智慧的基石。通過將多模態查詢和目標編碼為向量，它為工業搜索和推薦提供動力，並支撐現代代理。像抖音、小紅書和YouTube這樣的現實平台，擁有複雜的模態和大規模內容，要求在十億級索引下的效率和對困難匹配的細緻區分。現有的多模態嵌入模型很少同時滿足這兩個需求。對比模型效率高，但依賴於過於粗糙的對級監督，無法進行細緻的區分，而基於CoT的模型通過顯式生成來提高區分度，但在在線服務中不切實際。我們提出了抖音多模態嵌入（DME），這是一個分兩個階段訓練的模型，旨在結合這兩種優勢。第一階段進行大規模對比預訓練，建立一個統一的多模態嵌入空間，涵蓋廣泛的模態和任務。第二階段通過兩個機制補充語義充分性，該特性使嵌入基於檢索相關證據並保留細緻的對應側語義。證據驅動的類型潛在推理通過隱藏空間的潛在推理組織檢索證據，而交叉條件重建則通過交叉方向的自回歸重建強化對應側語義。這兩者僅在訓練期間起作用，並僅增加邊際查詢側開銷，因此DME的效率與標準對比編碼器相當。在MMEB-v2上，DME在其2B和9B變體（74.8和78.4）中達到了可比規模的最先進結果，特別是在視頻和視覺文檔任務上表現強勁。在生產中，DME在抖音的內部離線評估集上實現了2.92%的相對增益，並在生成、圖像和AI搜索等抖音場景中部署，並在抖音搜索的在線A/B測試中獲得了0.1%的終身（LT）增益。
